_doc: hour-of-week spread shape of the kit v2.1 markets (key = New York weekday*24 + hour, Mon = 0): in-sample (< 2022) mean of spread / median (close-quote) spread of its 17:00-NY trading day from the lab's Dukascopy one-minute bid/ask (lab/data/r3/<ticker>_m1.parquet; oil lab/data/lightcmdusd_m1.parquet), as kit/spread_shape.json except: 'shape' uses the OPEN quote (ao - bo) of the FIRST minute present in each hourly bar (the 09:30 opening quote for a share's 09 bar, where an order at the bar's open fills, as in the lab's frames), 'shape_close' the close quote of the LAST minute, and the ratio is NOT clipped to [0.7, 6] (the lab's share frames use the raw quotes, prep_round3.py; the clip, part of the forward-looking FP model, cut the opening spreads, 6-7 times the day's median, and the kit's cost came out 6-42 % below the lab's share frames); 1.0 where no bar was seen. Oil's data spread is constant: its shape is flat. Built by the kit v2.1 builder's scratch script build_extra.py.
